definitions.explanation: Moving one's residence to a different place, especially to a different country or region, with the intention of settling there permanently or for an extended period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{移住|いじゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{定年後|ていねんご}、⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{移住|いじゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More and more people are relocating to the countryside after retirement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地方|ちほう}{自治体|じちたい}→地方自治体：19063_chihoujichitai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{移住|いじゅう}⟦{希望者|きぼうしゃ}→希望者：03050_kibousha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けた→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}えている→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧。
examples.english: Local governments are putting together support programs for people who want to relocate.

notes:
USAGE:
Covers both international migration (emigration/immigration) and domestic relocation. In recent years, {移住|いじゅう} has been commonly used in Japan to refer to urban residents moving to rural areas, a trend encouraged by local governments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {海外|かいがい}{移住|いじゅう}: emigration overseas
- ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧{移住|いじゅう}: relocation to the countryside
- {移住|いじゅう}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧: destination of relocation
- {移住|いじゅう}{者|しゃ}: immigrant, settler
- {移住|いじゅう}⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧: relocation support
